headline: Ousted Bangladeshi leader vows to return from exile despite facing a death sentence
context: Hasina's speech marked the second anniversary of her ouster. She fled Bangladesh by helicopter following nearly two months of protests in 2024 that left nearly 1,400 people dead, according to the United Nations.
